name: crush-of-roses-android
description: Crush of Roses — Android wrapper (Capacitor thin shell) by Sloth Gaming Laboratory

scripts.build:dev: npm run sync:dev && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../crush-of-roses-dev.apk
scripts.build:live: npm run sync:live && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../crush-of-roses.apk
scripts.build:release-dev: npm run sync:dev && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease assembleRelease && cp app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab ../crush-of-roses-dev.aab && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../crush-of-roses-dev-release.apk
scripts.build:release-live: npm run sync:live && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease assembleRelease && cp app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab ../crush-of-roses.aab && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../crush-of-roses-release.apk

author: Sloth Gaming Laboratory
